full_details: The tables, still at the gate, said they have Venice now, and Hercules. The forty lines were a part in the morning, and the verse was not copied out. Phillips's jig of the slippers was kept as promised. Kemp was a cobbler, Arthur a scold in a borrowed kirtle, Sam a prentice who stole the shoes. You told Phillips that a man who cannot keep to eleven set lines keeps time to a hair for two hundred bars. He said Kemp will keep anything he made himself. Kemp, wet through, said he was first on the paper and first in the slippers. The yellow slippers stayed beside the cittern.
one_sentence: You read Venice and Hercules on a bill and did not go, then stood at the tiring-house door while Kemp kept the stage for a quarter of an hour.
title: Kemp was first in the slippers
